bugs_fixed.name: x86-merge-obj p111_program.caps bit 0x2 overwrite
bugs_fixed.root_cause: w10_merge_copy_root copied entry module m09 caps=7 (set3=True) into global p111_program+88; w10_merge_copy_one never bitwise-ANDed caps across merged modules, breaking Array.set/Array.get in m05/m01 (caps=5).
bugs_fixed.fix: Bitwise-AND each module's p111_mod_<mod>_program+88 into p111_program+88 via movq 88(%r8),%rax; movq 88(%r9),%rcx; andq %rax,%rcx; movq %rcx,88(%r9).

verification.before: n7_o2 x86-merge-obj m09 m09 m05 + C harness (m09=7, m05=5) -> merged_caps=7 (exit=1)
verification.after: exact 4-insn w10_merge_copy_one sequence + C harness (m09=7, m05=5) -> merged_caps=5 (exit=0); x187_e_alu verified to encode andq reg64, reg64

bugs_fixed.name: x86-iface v3 x198o_progress_get jmpq <self> infinite-loop thunk
bugs_fixed.root_cause: w14a_fast_abi_go2 called w13d_p113pl_candidates_fast (hardcoding signatures=[]) instead of p113pl_candidates(..., book_cached(nq_signatures(book, names), 0)) used by -O2 x86-object (p168_selected). Product-returning functions like x198o_progress_get (X198OProgress) were emitted as $direct stubs in m00.p130 while m00.o kept them CPS, causing m01.o to emit a 3-insn mov %rsi,%rdi; mov %rdx,%rsi; jmpq <self> infinite loop.
bugs_fixed.fix: Compute nq_sigs = book_cached(nq_signatures(book, names), 0) and call p113pl_candidates(book, pruned, bangs, nq_sigs) in w14a_fast_abi_go2.

verification.repro_before: 20-line repro_x198o.bend (1-ctor product MyProg): n6_o2 x86-object kept CPS (no p113d_FID), n6_o2 x86-iface emitted _cps count=0 (direct stub), caller emitted exact 48 89 f7 48 89 d6 e9 fb ff ff ff jmpq <self> loop
verification.control: repro_x198o_2ctor.bend (2-ctor MyProg2, not in nq_signatures): n6_o2 x86-object emitted p113d_FID_$direct.my_x198o_get2

bugs_fixed.name: w11_cmp_jcc_emit missing branch-target liveness check (w5c2_bits_nz xorl $1, %edx)
bugs_fixed.root_cause: w11_cmp_jcc_emit fused cmp+setcc+movzbl+movq+testl+jz into cmp+jcc while checking w5b_reg_dead_fast only on fallthrough tail, ignoring branch target lbl. When w5c2_bits16 inlined into w5c2_bits_nz, %edx was dead on fallthrough (ret) but live at .L_b0 (xorl $1, %edx), deleting sete %dl; movzbl %dl, %edx and reading uninitialized %edx.
bugs_fixed.fix: Pass after = Con{PInst{X187Instruction{w5b_j_cc(cc,flip),[X187Target{lbl}]}},tail} to w5b_reg_dead_fast(rA, after, fnItems) && w5b_reg_dead_fast(rB, after, fnItems) so w4b_reg_dead_branch checks both fallthrough and branch target lbl.

verification.repro_before: 15-line repro_bits.bend: n6_o2 x86/x86-object reproduced exact cmpq $1,%r8; jne .L_b0; ... .L_b0: xorl $1,%edx; movq %rdx,%r10
verification.deadness_audit: w5c_rd_br_jmp_f / w5c_rd_br_both_f verified to check both fallthrough and target label; all 8 other w5b_reg_dead_fast callers audited (straight-line only)
